purpose: PC-CROP federal accounting programme. Wave 1: job_profile as an axis orthogonal to user_orgs.role plus a deny-by-default membership capability resolver. Wave 2 first slice: signing authority, the gate that Wave 1 deliberately left closed. Approved by the owner on 2026-08-15 as a separate concurrent workstream that does not compete with IR-10.4.
requiredInvariants: job_profile is an axis orthogonal to user_orgs.role and never replaces it.
ORGANIZATION_HUMAN_ROLES and ROLE_CEILING in organization-role-policy.ts are unchanged; the nine market roles and registration authority #3785 do not regress.
ACCOUNTING keeps its existing bank/settlement meaning and is never repurposed as the organization bookkeeper; the compatibility pairing is role = GUEST with job_profile = ACCOUNTANT.
Capability resolution is deny-by-default: a revoked or pending membership, a non-active user, a forged profile name and the server-derived BANK_CALLBACK actor all resolve to no capabilities.
documents.sign is never granted by a job profile or a delegation; it stays gated by a signing authority record, and the database rejects it inside a delegation.
The migration is expand-only: one nullable column and one new table, no drop, no retype, no backfill, and no change to an existing grant, policy or constraint.
No column-level privilege is added to any existing identity principal, so no current runtime can read more than before.
The new table has RLS enabled and forced with no policy, denying every non-superuser principal until a later slice provisions one alongside its API.
No apps/web, packages, lockfile, settlement-engine or production change is included.
Merge, CI and image build are not production deployment evidence.
The platform never stores a signing private key; an authority record names a certificate by fingerprint only.
ukep_certificates is neither moved, renamed nor duplicated; the certificate stays user-level while authority is membership-level.
A delegated signer without a non-blank machine-readable power-of-attorney reference is refused by the policy and by a database CHECK constraint.
An empty allowed-document-type list means nothing is permitted and is refused at write time, never read as a wildcard.

Signing requires fresh MFA, a non-stale document, an active membership, matching tenant, organization and membership, a permitted document type, amount and signing mode, and a valid bound certificate.
documents.sign remains unmintable by job profile or delegation; the authority evaluator is the only gate and never accepts the capability as a substitute.
signing_authorities has RLS enabled and forced with no policy until a later slice provisions a principal alongside its API.

Accounting read policies never trust app.current_org_id or app.current_tenant_id on their own; membership is resolved from user_orgs rows by a SECURITY DEFINER function, because a setting the confined principal can write is not an authority.
pc_accounting_authority is read-only, column-scoped, and never receives the free-text delegation reason column.
One user holding memberships in two organizations reads only the organization it is currently acting in; switching organizations carries nothing across.
The isolation checks are wired into the RLS integration gate and are proven to fail when the policy or the grant is sabotaged.
acceptance: The eleven job profiles are exposed and share no identifier with the nine market roles.
Profile assignment is bounded by a ceiling: a director cannot mint an owner or another director, and non-administrative profiles can assign nothing.
Every one of the eleven profiles is proven to resolve without documents.sign, including OWNER.
A delegation carrying documents.sign is rejected in code and by a database CHECK constraint.
Delegations are honoured only inside their window, with the end bound exclusive, and only while status is ACTIVE.
A delegation cannot revive a revoked membership.
Resolution is identical across all nine market roles for the same job profile, proving the role axis never widens the accounting contour.
The external accountant is denied period close, reconciliation and provider configuration while keeping daily bookkeeping.
Exact-head API typecheck introduces no new error, the full API unit suite passes, and the forward-only migration gate passes before merge.
No new recurring cost is introduced.
Every deny reason is reported together rather than one at a time, so a disabled action can explain itself completely.
A security hold refuses an otherwise fully valid signature.
Nine signing-authority invariants are proven against a live PostgreSQL 16, not only asserted in tests.
prisma migrate diff reports no drift after applying both PC-CROP migrations.

Nine isolation checks run in the RLS integration gate: own-row read, forged organization, forged tenant, dual-organization member in each direction, delegation recipient, absent context, write refusal and withheld-column refusal.
Deliberate sabotage of the policy (trusting the setting alone) and of the grant (adding UPDATE) each make the gate exit non-zero.
notYetApproved: Waves 2-12 of the programme. Each must request its own scope manifest.
Any apps/web surface, including the accounting dashboard and Connection Center.
Any vendor activation for 1C, EDO, FGIS Zerno or IS EPD.
notes: This manifest records an owner decision; it does not create authority on its own. The truth audit that motivated it is docs/ops/pc-crop-federal-accounting/gap-matrix.md and the blocker it resolves is documented in governance-blocker.md.
